agentTools.title: Suggest follow-ups
agentTools.description: Offer the user 1-5 short next actions for this conversation, shown as a dismissible pill above their composer once your turn ends. Call this once near the end of a turn, only when there are genuinely useful next steps you did not already take (verify a change, widen the scope, ship it, investigate a nearby risk). Each action needs a label of at most 30 characters written as an imperative the user would say, an optional one-line description, and the exact prompt to submit if it is chosen. Set preferredActionId to the one you would recommend. This never blocks or changes your turn: it returns immediately and the user may ignore it entirely. Do not call it to ask a question, to confirm something you need an answer to before continuing, or to repeat work you already finished.

actions.description: The offered next actions, most useful first.

id.description: Short identifier unique within this call.

label.description: Pill text, at most 30 characters, phrased as an imperative.

description.description: Optional single line explaining what the action does.

prompt.description: Prompt submitted verbatim if the user picks this action.

preferredActionId.description: Id of the action to show first; defaults to the first action.
